paraphrase.proposes: The track draws the 31 card rows that list v7 adds to the Storytime Level 2 print list. Each card needs a color picture and a line-art picture, so the track delivers 62 files at 1500 x 1500 px. It reuses the approved Storytime Muse path, the frozen Sonnet judge kit, and the week delivery form, and it adds one card run constant CARD_RUN to the guard module. It also moves the T180 version 3 list fixture into tests/fixtures/storytime/pictures-v3.json and pins list v7 as tests/fixtures/storytime/pictures-v7.json. The spend cap is 1.60 USD, the delivery is model evidence only, and Workbooks checks the cards after delivery.
paraphrase.current_system: The closed unit 1 track holds the Muse path: scripts/storytime-muse.mjs calls meta/muse-image through OpenRouter and writes the print file to the spec outDir. scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs scans every costs.tsv below out/storytime/l2/unit1/, and it enforces 3 tries per id and kind against a 1.00 USD restart cap that counts rows since 2026-11-04T07:54:00Z. scripts/storytime-judge-batch.mjs builds judge batches for the A-48 specs with a fixed SPEC_DIR and a 360 px long side for a card, and its parseArgs takes only --ids, --kind, --try, and --out. The delivery form is the StorytimeManifest object in src/storytime/book-pictures.ts with the MANIFEST.txt form of the week handoff. Two tests read the version 3 list from /tmp/opencode/wb-shadow, and that path is not in git.
